_comment: Commits the triage flags that are deliberately absent from the changelog. Each needs a reason a reviewer can check. This is judgement made visible, not judgement removed: the script still fails on anything not listed here.

b2f0341e.reason: False positive. This PR documents that merging no longer closes issues; its body QUOTES `Fixes #727, #703, #709, #728` as an example of the accident it is describing. It closes nothing.

ca0b1a5b.reason: chelis#1333 is `nightly-failure, release blocking` — a failing SMT Full Prove nightly, not user-visible behaviour. The fix isolates cvc5 in the unit-test lane and changes no compiler output.
